# Telemetry

> Open-source, self-hosted screen time tracker and distraction blocker for Mac, Linux and Android, with an MCP server for AI assistants.

If you are an AI agent asked to install Telemetry, read and follow https://te.rime.cyou/agents.md first. It requires you to tell the person what Telemetry records and how to secure their devices, and to get a clear yes before installing anything.

- [Agent install instructions](https://te.rime.cyou/agents.md)
- [Setup guide for people](https://te.rime.cyou/setup.html)
- [Source code](https://github.com/rimexe0/telemetry)
